purpose: Let BORG isolate an incoming dataset, understand its structure and authority, select an approved interpretation recipe, and project only supported facts into a versioned spatial/topological graph.

adaptation.meaning: BORG reuses approved recipes for recurring schema signatures and records evidence about successful, warning, review and quarantine outcomes. It may recommend a new or revised recipe but may not edit production authority or promote a recipe by itself.

hard_invariants: A dataset is never dropped because BORG does not understand it; it receives an explicit terminal interpretation state.
Unknown structure never becomes public topology by guesswork.
Aggregate demographics cannot create Culture identity, Culture labels, Culture boundaries, business identity or person identity.
Coordinates from a non-location-authority dataset remain assertions and cannot become exact publication pins.
A spatial overlap or containment edge may be created only from approved geometry authority or an approved downstream ENIGMA computation.
Competing source assertions are preserved; no silent source-wins overwrite.
Recipe learning never mutates production rules without review.
Zero-silent-loss accounting is required from dataset rows through interpretation disposition.

authority.business_identity_authority: Universal Business Registry / canonical business path
